podcast.title: Influence on Madonna's "Cherish" (1989)
podcast.body: Madonna's song "Cherish" drew inspiration from 60s Sunshine Pop, blending it with Doo-wop and girl group energy, in a style reminiscent of "True Blue." "elements of Dewap and 60's Sunshine Pop."
